messages:
customer-acme: Hey team — we're getting a bunch of 429s this morning on project `acme-prod` between 08:15-08:25 UTC. Dashboard shows ~remaining quota for the hour but the API is rejecting. Can you help triage?

emma (support): Sorry about that — can you paste the exact error body you saw and a curl repro?

customer-acme: Error payload: `{
  "error": "rate_limited",
  "code": 429,
  "detail": "project quota exceeded: rolling window limit"
}`
Curl we used: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-7b","input":"hello"}'`
We started at 08:10 and saw failures spike ~08:16. Dashboard (project -> quota) shows 80% used for last hour but not full. :confused:

emma (support): Thanks. @raj can you check metering logs + rate-limit service for that project/time? Also @luis fyi in case it's billing/metering-side counting differences.

raj (infra): Looking now. I see a cluster of metering events arriving out-of-order due to a consumer restart around 08:14. There are duplicate ingestion attempts from the metering backfill worker — looks like the backfill retried and produced duplicate usage events for `acme-prod` across the 60s windows.

sre-bot: deploy consumer-metrics-v2 08:13 succeeded on infra-05 :white_check_mark:

raj (infra): The duplicate events primarily impacted the rolling-window aggregator. It counts tokens into minute buckets; because duplicates landed in two adjacent minute buckets it artificially bumped the rolling 60m total above the threshold for a short time, causing 429s even though the per-hour dashboard (which uses deduped invoice-ready aggregates) reported lower usage.

emma (support): So dashboard vs API limit are using slightly different pipelines: dashboard = post-dedupe invoice pipeline, API limit = pre-dedupe rolling aggregator. That could explain why invoice/dashboard looked fine. Is that a correct summary @luis?

luis (billing): Correct. Billing pipeline runs dedupe+normalization before it computes the per-project hourly totals (used for invoices). The rate-limit service uses a lower-latency stream and does limited dedupe (only by request_id); if duplicates don't include the same request_id they can be double-counted.

customer-acme: Is there a mitigation? We need the API to stop throwing 429s — this impacted customer-facing flows.

raj (infra): Short-term mitigation: I can pause the backfill worker and manually de-duplicate the recent minute buckets for `acme-prod`. That should shrink the rolling window count and clear the quota. Doing that now.

emma (support): We'll let you know when that's done. Also collecting exact request_ids from your logs would help if there are specific duplicates.

raj (infra): Done — paused backfill, ran dedupe for 08:12-08:18 window, and issued an emergency decrement to rate-limit counters for acme-prod. API 429s should stop within ~30s as counters converge. :rocket:

customer-acme: Confirmed — errors dropped after ~40s. Thanks. Any permanent fix?

raj (infra): Long-term fixes: 1) make the rolling aggregator resilient to duplicate ingestion by adding a dedupe layer keyed by (project_id, request_id, event_hash) before incrementing buckets, 2) add stronger at-most-once guarantees on the metering consumer retries, 3) unify a reconciliation job that aligns rate-limit counters with billing aggregates every 5m for high-risk projects. I'll open an infra ticket.

luis (billing): Also will add an alert that fires when rolling-window totals differ from billing aggregates by >5% for a project for 3 consecutive windows — should catch regressions earlier.

emma (support): I'm creating a post-incident follow-up with customer-facing notes and a suggested config to avoid hitting backfill windows (e.g., schedule bulk replays during low-traffic windows).

customer-acme: Appreciate the quick response. For transparency can you share the ticket numbers and whether this will affect our invoice?

emma (support): Ticket created: INFRA-8421 (metering consumer dedupe + reconciliation). Billing follow-up: BILL-291. @luis will confirm invoice impact — my expectation is no invoice change because billing uses deduped pipeline.

luis (billing): Confirmed — invoices won't change for this window. I'll add a note on BILL-291 with a reconciliation snapshot and why the API 429s happened.

emma (support): Closing loop here — please reopen if you see further 429s. Thanks everyone. :heart:

sre-bot: incident-link: https://redwood-incidents.internal/incidents/INFRA-8421
